name: Maxigun Test (Veterancy research)
description: Test build, not for release: logs the M-1000 Maxigun's fire rates, spin-up, backpack and kill credit, and applies the test values in maxigun-test.ini (fire rate slots, spin-up and spin-down, firing on the move, recoil, backpack size) so Veterancy System's Maxigun levels can be planned. Solo or host.
